messages:
Marie L.: Morning — I pushed the final draft of the new product launch post for Optimize. Need a quickpass on the hero quote, one benchmark sentence, CTA wording, and preferred publish time. Doc: https://go/redwood/optimize-launch-draft :wave:

Devin: On it. I'll skim hero + benchmarks in the next 30. Can we aim for a 10am PT publish? More traffic then.

Jess: Saw a small copy tweak: the bench line currently says 'reduces tokens by 40%' — can we make it 'reduces effective token cost by ~40%' to be precise?

Marie L.: Good call Jess, that wording is better. Also need a short CTO quote — Samir can you confirm the quote below or tweak?

Samir: Sharing a short suggestion:
```
"Optimize lets teams cut inference cost without sacrificing latency — it makes serving decisions practical at scale."
```
Happy to tweak.

Devin: Love that. Maybe shorten to: 
```
"Optimize helps teams cut inference cost while keeping latency production-ready."
```
I think it reads nicer in the hero. :+1:

Jess: Approved the bench wording change. For CTA, propose: 'Try Optimize free — get tailored batching suggestions and cost estimates.' Thoughts?

Marie L.: CTA sounds clear. One ask from growth: add HubSpot UTMs so we can attribute webinar signups. UTM: `?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=optimize_launch&utm_medium=post`

Samir: UTMs fine. Legal, any red flags on the quote + bench line? @LegalBot can you quickpass?

LegalBot: Quickpass complete — no product claims flagged. Suggest minor hedge on 'production-ready' -> 'production-grade' to avoid absolute language.

Samir: OK, will change 'production-ready' to 'production-grade' in the quote. New quote: 
```
"Optimize helps teams cut inference cost while keeping latency production-grade."
```
All good from me.

Devin: Quick editorial note: hero should stay under 120 chars for social card. Samir quote is 86 chars — good. Benchmark sentence (after Jess edit) is 12 words — also good.

Marie L.: Schedule: let's publish 10am PT tomorrow unless someone objects. @PublishBot can you schedule the post and include UTMs and the CTA link to the webinar signup?

PublishBot: Scheduled to publish at 2026-03-22T10:00:00-07:00. Assets attached to the post: hero quote, bench snippet, CTA with UTM. Reminder: run smoke check at T-30m. :robot_face:

Jess: I'll do the T-30m smoke copy pass and check embed/code snippets.

Devin: I'll queue social snippets and the benchmark thread.

Marie L.: Thanks team — this quickpass was perfect. If anything changes ping here. :sparkles:
